package.name: lerobot_mujoco
package.description: Standalone, self-contained MuJoCo simulator for the SO-101 arm: its own local copy of the URDF and meshes lives in urdf/ and meshes/ (no lerobot_description or xacro dependency), and it replays the same named forward-kinematics poses from lerobot_moveit/config/so101.srdf using MuJoCo's own physics and position servos, with no ROS 2 nodes, move_group, or controller stack required.
